captionDefinition.manualEnglish: An English key such as en or en-orig exists under yt-dlp subtitles.
captionDefinition.automaticEnglish: An English key such as en or en-orig exists under yt-dlp automatic_captions.

scopeNotes: Counts are a public channel snapshot and will change as the channel publishes, removes, or reclassifies assets.
Standalone VODs and stream archives often represent the same sermon and must be grouped before train/dev/test splitting.
Automatic captions are raw source material, not human-reviewed gold transcripts.
Public availability and caption availability do not establish model-training or redistribution rights.
